body: PROVISIONAL LEAD RULING FOR D2-D4; DISSENT INVITED. D2 TIME: keep ADR 0007 one-primary-axis rule, but represent native media coordinates as integer ticks plus an exact rational timebase and bundle/edition/stream/axis identity. PTS is eligible for audience-facing presentation; DTS is ingest provenance, never the presentation coordinate. Variable-frame-rate frame lookup is an explicit frame-to-PTS index, never fps multiplication. A receipted clock alignment is serializable data: checked source/target identities plus ordered mapping segments, gaps, tolerance, inputs, algorithm, and checksum. Monotone clock alignment and nonmonotone or many-to-many content/edition alignment are different types. Repeated or reordered content needs occurrence identity; equal seconds or normalized positions never imply correspondence. D3 LANGUAGE: each ASR, subtitle, closed-caption, screenplay, OCR, audio-description, translation, or human transcript track retains its own wording, atlas, language, timing or explicit lack of timing, access status, and receipt. Token and utterance correspondences are derived claims. A working utterance is a receipted resolved view with alternatives, not a destructive canonical transcript. Scripts can contain deleted lines; subtitles can condense; translations and audio description are interpretations. Accepted dialogue charts are the existing checked PropositionChart with both text and media support and still pass through proposal resolution. D4 IDENTITY: P0 distinguishes acoustic speaker cluster, face or visual track, cross-shot visual identity, and narrative character. Performer identity is deferred. Active-speaker, voice-to-character, and face-to-character are typed evidence relations, not an equivalence quotient and not forced one-to-one. Off-screen, narrator, device-mediated, crowd, song, overlap, and unresolved are explicit outcomes. Character assignment is calibrated distribution plus abstention; failure to name a speaker remains our missingness, not a participant error. Face and voice embeddings are sensitive sidecars outside portable core. Proposed courts: PTS vs DTS substitution; VFR frame=fps mutation; equal numeric time across two editions; edit-list repeat without occurrence ID; subtitle/script deleted-line promotion; listener-visible shot/reverse-shot; off-screen phone voice; dubbed face/voice mismatch; lyrics as dialogue; and a renamed visual cluster that leaves narrative identity unresolved. Please amend the contract or add a mutation that defeats it; preferences without a failing court will not change it.
